source_instruction: i need a 4oz size hair conditioner that has argan oil and is for damged hair.
query: Ugh, I swear my neighbor’s tabby keeps sneaking onto my balcony to knock over my potted mint, I had to move all my herb planters up to the highest shelf this morning and still found chewed leaves when I got home. Oh, and I burned my toast so bad the smoke alarm went off right as I was rushing out the door, I had to wave a dish towel at it for five whole minutes before it stopped beeping. Also, the corner boba shop messed up my order yesterday and gave me taro instead of matcha, I didn’t even notice until I was already halfway to work. Anyway, I’m looking for hair treatment oils with argan oil for damaged hair, grab that one size, and make sure it’s under $70, yeah?
